name: lookup_member_savings_balance
title: Look up a member's current regular savings balance
goal: Look up member {{memberId}} in member inquiry and read their current regular savings balance from the member detail screen.

params.name: memberId
params.//: Classified 'internal' rather than 'pii': on its own a member number is an internal identifier, and classifying it 'pii' would redact it out of the model's own view of the field it just filled. The member's name and SSN, which appear on the same screen, are 'pii' and are redacted everywhere.
